# Abū Manṣūr al-Māturīdī

*853 – 944 · Central Asian · [Kalām](../movements/kalam.md)*

A theologian from Samarkand, founder of the Māturīdite school, the other great Sunni theology of [kalām](../movements/kalam.md) alongside Ashʿarism.
